cd /testbed && grep -nE 'ACLLoad|aclLoad|ACL LOAD|free.*User|FreeUser|authenticated' src/acl.c && sed -n '2450,2830p' src/acl.c
cd /testbed && ls tests/unit/*acl* tests/unit/*repl* && grep -nE 'ACL LOAD|acl load|aclfile|start_server|replicaof' tests/unit/acl*.tcl | head -150 && sed -n '1,150p' /opt/peeky/docs/lang/c-cpp.md

cd /testbed && sed -n '450,520p' src/acl.c && sed -n '2200,2420p' src/acl.c && grep -nE 'user = NULL|user = DefaultUser|createClient|cached_master' src/networking.c src/replication.c | head -100 && ls -l src/valkey-server src/valkey-cli 2>/dev/null

cd /testbed && sed -n '950,1240p' tests/unit/acl.tcl && grep -nE 'start_server|wait_for_sync|wait_for_condition|replicaof|slaveof' tests/integration/replication.tcl | head -70 && sed -n '1,100p' tests/integration/replication.tcl && command -v apply_patch

cd /testbed && sed -n '1940,2020p' src/replication.c && grep -nE '!c->user|c->user == NULL|c->user &&|if \(c->user\)' src/acl.c src/networking.c src/server.c src/module.c && grep -n 'proc wait_for_sync\|proc wait_for_ofs_sync' tests/support/*.tcl && grep -nE 'acl.*load|ACL.*LOAD|replicaof|slaveof' tests/unit/acl*.tcl && cat tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl && cat tests/assets/user.acl && ls -l /usr/bin/patch /usr/local/bin/apply_patch /opt/peeky/bin/peeky 2>/dev/null

cd /testbed && sed -n '1,100p' runtest && grep -nE 'single|only|force|clients|verbose' tests/test_helper.tcl | head -65 && grep -nE '^\.PHONY|^all:|^default:|^FINAL_CFLAGS|^CFLAGS|^OPT' src/Makefile && git log -3 --oneline

cd /testbed; grep -nE '!c->user|c->user == NULL|c->user &&|if \(c->user\)' src/acl.c src/networking.c src/server.c src/module.c; grep -n 'proc wait_for_sync\|proc wait_for_ofs_sync' tests/support/*.tcl; grep -nE 'acl.*load|ACL.*LOAD|replicaof|slaveof' tests/unit/acl*.tcl; cat tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl tests/assets/user.acl; command -v patch; command -v apply_patch; sed -n '1250,1330p' tests/unit/acl.tcl
cd /testbed && grep -nE 'wait_for_sync|wait_for_ofs_sync' tests/support/util.tcl && sed -n '1,90p' tests/assets/default.conf && grep -nE 'primary.*user|user.*NULL|!user' src/acl.c | head -65; ls /opt
cd /testbed && sed -n '105,150p' tests/support/util.tcl && sed -n '2895,2928p' src/acl.c && sed -n '1100,1128p' tests/unit/acl.tcl && git status --short

cd /testbed && patch -p1 <<'PATCH'
--- a/tests/unit/acl.tcl
+++ b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
@@ -1117,3 +1117,30 @@
 }
 
+set server_path [tmpdir "server.acl-replica"]
+exec cp -f tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl $server_path
+start_server {tags {"acl repl external:skip"}} {
+    start_server [list overrides [list "dir" $server_path "aclfile" "nodefaultuser.acl"]] {
+        test {ACL LOAD on a replica preserves replication} {
+            set primary [srv -1 client]
+            set replica [srv 0 client]
+
+            $replica replicaof [srv -1 host] [srv -1 port]
+            wait_for_sync $replica
+
+            $replica ACL SETUSER alice -set
+            $replica ACL SETUSER temporary on nopass +@all ~*
+            assert_equal OK [$replica ACL LOAD]
+            assert_equal "+@all" [dict get [$replica ACL GETUSER alice] commands]
+            assert_equal {} [$replica ACL GETUSER temporary]
+
+            # The primary connection must remain unrestricted by local ACLs.
+            $replica ACL SETUSER default -set
+            assert_error {*NOPERM*} {$replica SET acl-reload-key value}
+            $primary SET acl-reload-key value
+            wait_for_ofs_sync $primary $replica
+            assert_equal value [$replica GET acl-reload-key]
+        }
+    }
+}
+
 set server_path [tmpdir "resetchannels.acl"]
PATCH
./runtest --single unit/acl --only 'ACL LOAD on a replica preserves replication' > /tmp/valkey-acl-baseline.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -85 /tmp/valkey-acl-baseline.log; exit "$result"
cd /testbed && ./runtest --single unit/acl --single unit/acl-v2 > /tmp/valkey-acl-suites.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -30 /tmp/valkey-acl-suites.log; exit "$result"

cd /testbed && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/acl.c tests/unit/acl.tcl && git status --short; grep -A18 -B4 -m1 'STACK TRACE' /tmp/valkey-acl-baseline.log; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.orig' -o -name '*.rej' -o -name 'core' -o -name 'core.*' \) -print

cd /testbed && rm -f src/acl.c.orig tests/unit/acl.tcl.orig /tmp/valkey-acl-build.log /tmp/valkey-acl-baseline.log /tmp/valkey-acl-fixed.log /tmp/valkey-acl-suites.log && git diff --check && git status --short
